jobs_results.title: Data & AI Accelerators Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
AstraZeneca is a global, innovation-driven biopharmaceutical business that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world's most serious diseases. But we're more than one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we're proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Department – R&D IT

R&D IT’s vision is to deliver the best science IT capabilities in biopharma, which we define as agile, responsive and fit-for-future. Our goal is to engage with our stakeholders as a strategic partner in delivering life-changing medicines to our patients. The desired effect of your role is to take accountability as a leader for delivering a ‘Best in Class’ IT experience within R&D IT.

Delivering the portfolio of projects and services... needs people with hybrid skill sets covering technical, analytical, project management, service management, BRM and business analysis skills, combined with an excellent knowledge of AZ Finance and Global Product and Portfolio Strategy processes. Our project managers lead or contribute to a range of projects including IT development, data management, analytics, AI, machine learning, business transformation and more. Our projects deploy a range of technologies including internal custom build solutions, packaged software, ERP solutions, Software as a Service as well as Cloud based solutions and BI tools.

Role

The IT Project Manager leads technology and/or business transformation projects/programs to ensure that they align to the vision and business strategy, and that true business value is delivered to the customer as a result. Having a strong partnership with the business and IT customer driving the demand for the solution is critical to success in this role.

The IT Project Manager is accountable for ensuring solutions solve key business needs in an integrated and simple manner, exploiting existing assets where feasible, and minimizing the long-term total cost of ownership. The role must also ensure that delivery occurs with a sense of urgency and speediness of response and can be completed within the approved program budget and schedule commitments, whilst continuously assessing risk and balancing the need for flexibility and agility with conformance to standard methods and tools.

Focus areas include stakeholder management across Business, IT, and vendor partners, risk management and delivery of business benefit. This role is also required to collaborate with others in Program and Project Management, and drive development of the project / program management capability across IT in a tangible and measurable way.

Key Responsibilities
• Leading cross-functional IT projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
• Working closely with R&D teams to understand their IT needs, translating these requirements into effective project plans and technology solutions.
• Managing and optimizing the engineering enablement capabilities, including DevOps, MLOps, CloudOps, security measures, process templates, and automation solutions.
• Serving as an Agile Scrum Master, facilitating daily scrum meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospective meetings to ensure continuous improvement within the team.
• Coordinating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure the seamless integration of new technologies and systems into the existing R&D IT infrastructure.
• Developing and maintaining comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, risk assessments, and stakeholder communications.
• Implementing and advocating for best practices in project management and Agile methodologies within the team to improve efficiency and productivity.
• Overseeing the project budget, including forecasting, tracking expenses, and ensuring financial efficiency.
• Identifying, assessing, and mitigating project risks and issues, implementing solutions to overcome obstacles and ensure project success.
• Championing the adoption of automation solutions and process improvements across data and analytics platforms to enhance R&D operations.
• Facilitating knowledge sharing and skills development within the team, ensuring team members are up-to-date with the latest in technology trends and project management methodologies.
• Collaborating with the IT security team to ensure that all projects comply with regulatory requirements and company security policies.

Candidate Knowledge, Skills and Experience
• Technical, Science or Business degree or equivalent years of experience.
• At least 5 years of Project Management experience, ideally in a Pharmaceutical IT environment.
• Experience working in global organization and across cultural boundaries.
• Experience in Agile Project Management.
• Demonstrated skills interacting with Senior Leaders.
• Experience leading large projects /programs.
• Experience working with third party suppliers.
• Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
• Excellent relationship management, and influencing skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset and the proven ability to shape innovative solutions.
• Well-developed organizational, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

Desirable Requirements:
• Master's degree preferred.
• Program/Project Management certifications preferred (Prince, PMP, MSP, Agile – Scrum, SAFe).
• Experience with data management tools and techniques such as ETL and data virtualization.

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Who are we looking for?

You are a good fit if you like to coordinate between client, stakeholders and your team. We want you to be part of our team, if you are a good communicator, who knows how to identify customer requirements and manages future business solutions. Resting on your laurels is not familiar to you, nor is it for us.

What do we require?
• Focus on building & maintaining a strong relationship to our clients, respecting their needs and identifying business opportunities
• Experience in requirements management and ability to conceptualize the clients expectations
• Experience in managing medium size contracts and their budgets
• Having at least 1-2 years of experience as a Project Manager or equivalent position
• Ability to moderate workshops, presentations and discussions
• Documentation of complex topics concisely and comprehensibly
• Creating a communication plan and managing its execution
• Excellent... organizational and time management skills
• Acting as a trusted advisor for customers and colleagues
• With the input of the technical team, all technical topics can be discussed and explained to our clients
• Capability to manage a project team, including sub-contractors
• Business travel is not an issue for you
• Fluent (native level) Spanish
• Fluent English
• Eligibility to work within the EU

What makes us smile when looking at your profile
• Experience with Adobe CQ5 or AEM related web projects
• A proactive mind-set, ability to share your ideas and bring them to life
• Enthusiasm
• An open mind which is looking for continuous improvement
• Willingness to develop a stronger understanding of the projects technical components
• Receiving and giving feedback is familiar to you, something you are not afraid of

What we can offer you:
• Permanent contract
• 30 working days of vacation for all employees
• Flexible working hours, with respect to project needs
• Recognition bonus system
• Apple work equipment
• Continuous training and coaching
• Free language classes to polish your English or help you with your Spanish
• Truly international team
• Free Private health insurance
• Tax free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarden and transport)
• Sponsored gym membership
• A central office location closed to the Mercado Progreso
• Many off-site company events, including our annual company summits
• Everyone has a voice, we are a Holacracy organization

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager, Professional Services
jobs_results.description:
About the position:

Netskope’s Global Customer Experience team is continuing to grow its project management practice. This role reports into Netskope’s Customer Experience Professional Services team.

Responsibilities include:
• Drive project kick-off activities: internal meetings, statement of work creation, project plan documentation for top-tier, high profile customers.
• Act as an escalation path for implementation projects to reset and clarify expectations.
• Oversee Netskope's customer installation engagements from a technical project management capacity.
• Schedule and oversee assignments, report on risks, issues, and accomplishments.
• Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal Netskope team members.
• Provide regular project updates to customers and Netskope leadership.
• Manage internal customer-related processes regarding scheduling, finance, and resource management.

Job Requirements:
• 6-8 years Project Management experience in services business or... team.
• Prior experience with Customer Success and/or Professional Services solutions, including Financial Force and Gainsight.
• Experience with resource management.
• Experience with project planning software, plus Smartsheet.
• Excellent interpersonal verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to self-manage - the team is globally distributed.
• Practical knowledge within the network security and/or SaaS industry.
• Proficient skills presenting complex schedules and tracking.
• The voice of calm in the chaos and ability to thrive with competing priorities.

Preferences:
• Technical experience implementing network security and/or SaaS-based solutions.
• Professional Services or Customer Success experience.
• Successful track record working with Fortune 500 companies.
• Successful track record working within a successful startup(s).

Education:
• Bachelor's Degree

#LI-NN1

Netskope focuses on Enterprise Software, Enterprise Security, Data Security, Software, and Mobile Security. Their company has offices in San Francisco, London, Melbourne, Santa Clara, and Tokyo. They have a very large team that's between 1001-5000 employees. To date, Netskope has raised $1.162B of funding; their latest round was closed on January 2023.

You can view their website at https://www.netskope.com or find them on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Product Hunt

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description: General information Lead the execution of medium-size projects and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with policy, contractual agreements, quality standards, health, safety & environment requirements, financial targets, as well as schedule commitments. The Projects would be related with our Grid Integration business (substations, power quality, e-mobility, etc). Your responsibilities Lead the project team allocated to the project, defining main guidelines, allocating project tasks, and motivating and monitoring internal and external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones. Provide performance feedback regarding allocated resources working on projects; Define, jointly with the Project Controls department, all project plan documents, including scope and financial plans, schedule and risk management plans; Ensure that the project follows execution best practices and policies. Effectively monitor and control project progress and efficient resource... utilization. Monitor and control project financials, overseeing project invoicing status, cost, expenses and cash flow. Identify, qualify, quantify and manage project risks, and ensure that all opportunities are identified and pursued. Capture, analyze and share lessons learned throughout the project. Ensure that the project is formally closed out, as contractually agreed. Drive the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out and its acknowledgement by the customer. Ensure that the project consistently applies contract and claims management, in accordance with policies and contractual agreements. Coordinate with Supply Chain Management, and successfully procures required services, materials and equipment for the project from external and internal suppliers. Support Supply Chain Management in supplier negotiations, claims and project changes. Act as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. Ensure the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies. Live core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business. Your background A bachelor’s/master’s degree in Engineering More than 5 years of professional experience, including more than 2 years in project management. Additional training in the area of project management Demonstrated experience in management of project scope, cost, schedules and vendors/subcontractor Demonstrated experience and knowledge of the energy business Customer oriented, with excellent organization and strong communication skills. Mastery in balancing stakeholders, both external and internal. Fluent in English and Spanish is a must, both written and spoken. French is also valuable Current work permit valid in Spain. Available to travel up to 20% of the time

jobs_results.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Location & work modality: Rubí / Barcelona Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

Start: ASAP

Type of Contract: Full Time / Permanent

About Submer

The best way to introduce you to Submer is undoubtedly through our values: Sustainable, Unique, Bold, Making Sense, Empathetic and Reliable. If these resonate with you we're sure you will find your place here in no time.

At Submer, we believe that our digital world can be more sustainable, more efficient and more environmentally friendly. Submer is solving the biggest problems of datacenter, supercomputer, hyperscale and edge applications to make that future possible.

Our multinational talented team has a huge passion in reducing IT environmental footprint and expertise in datacenter design and day-to-day operations. We’re scaling our team and operations worldwide to meet growing international demand.

What impact you will have

As an Agile Project Manager experienced Scrum Master adept at driving Agile methodologies and nurturing synergistic... collaboration within diverse, cross-functional teams. The role entails overseeing the development of two hardware products alongside a software team, ensuring seamless integration across both domains. Proficient in identifying and resolving impediments, the Scrum Master is instrumental in streamlining processes to enhance project delivery efficiency.

What you’ll do:
• Facilitate Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) ensuring active participation and adherence to the Scrum process.
• Practice servant leadership by empowering and supporting the Scrum Team to self-organize and achieve their goals while shielding them from external distractions and impediments.
• Identify and remove blockers hindering the team's progress, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve organizational issues impacting the team.
• Coach team members and the organization on agile principles and Scrum practices, promoting collaboration among team members, stakeholders, and other Scrum roles.
• Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to ensure clear communication and alignment on project goals.
• Facilitate regular retrospectives to reflect on processes and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing new practices to enhance team efficiency.
• Assist the team in establishing and monitoring relevant metrics to track performance and progress, providing insights through metrics such as burndown charts and velocity.
• Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements, provide updates, and manage expectations, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and stakeholders.
• Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and status updates, and generate regular progress reports for stakeholders and leadership.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree in Business administration, Project Management, or a related field such as Engineering (master’s preferred).
• Proven experience as a Scrum Master in hardware product development (minimum 5 years).
• Proficiency in Jira.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
• Outstanding organizational and multitasking capabilities.
• Native English is required, and good working knowledge of Spanish is preferred (other languages are a plus).
• Proactive self-starter with clear internal and external communication skills.
• Strong critical thinking skills.

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• Restaurant Pass.
• Private Health Insurance.
• A healthy work environment with fresh fruits to energise and an on-site gym for active breaks.
• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our Inclusive Responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law

jobs_results.title: API Technical  Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
AXA Group Operations is the IT solutions and business consulting provider of the AXA Group, one of the world's leading insurance and financial protection companies. We develop and operate transverse business solutions at international scale.

Working for the different companies of the AXA group, AXA Services has a worldwide action field with offices in 16 countries.

Our mission is to shape, build and maintain the shared solutions of AXA Group. The aim of these services is to sustain business development, reduce time to market, & generate savings.

Environment:

This resource will join a team of IT professionals involved in solution delivery and maintenance activities delivered by the API Management applicative team for the AXA Group.

Main tasks and responsibilities

· Do the scoping and manage technical projects (planning, workload, risks)

· Design APIs and provide high level support during UAT to the team (support user during their tests), ncluding defect management processes,

·... Ensure defined process is respected (change, defect, management).

· Deliver project documentation

· Develop APIs on webMethods when needed

· Review, check the quality and test APIs provided by developers

· Lead a small team (<5 persons)

· Manage Applicaitve BAU, Provide symptom check, critical situation analysis, recovery planning and implementation

· Single Point Of Contact for our client to adress all other teams (Platform, Operations) or sub product (moniotring, network, etc)

· Onboarding of junior members

· Ability to provide low level transversal knowledge between projects belonging to different companies inside our Group to increase the quality

Your Profile

Professional and technical skills

Technical Skills:

Experience: 3 to 5 years experience as Software AG/ web Methods developer and a first experience as project management

Must Have:

· First experience in technical project management to implement APIs using a Middleware

· REST and SOAP

· Knowledge on API gateways

Nice to Have:
• Broadcom Layer 7 experience
• webMethods experience
• Java development
• ELK knowledge

· Ability to travel / ability to be relocated for short periods in other countries.

Non-Technical Skills:
• Experience working alongside internal and external providers in an international context;
• Be required to work in professional cross teams environments, and at times, work autonomously;
• Communicating clearly, politely and respectfully in person, by telephone and in writing
• Explaining complex technical information simply
• Bringing people into conversations to ensure the right people are involved
• Knowing how to adapt to different people
• Degree in a relevant area, such as, Computer Science or similar education;
• Availability to work out of regular working hours if ocasionaly required;

Nice to have: Agility

Language

English: Independent user (C1 in Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

Spanish: Independent user – it’s a plus

Portuguese: Independent user – it’s a plus

French: Independent user – it’s a plus

About AXA

As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working with 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of
respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can.

About the Entity

AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation.

We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution.

We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary.

At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action:
• State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience
• State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks
• High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities

What We Offer

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Healthcare
jobs_results.description:
Technical Project Manager

London, United Kingdom

Remote

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Project Manager to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the delivery of technical solutions for clients.

They will facilitate internal and external meetings to gather business process requirements, use cases, and configuration.

The Technical Project Manager must ensure that contract scope and milestones are met on time and within budget. They will be responsible for generating and reviewing change order proposals with stakeholders.

The Technical Project Manager will drive effective communication with external and internal teams and stakeholders to ensure that project status, client deliverables, and scope are understood.

They will coordinate delivery with release management, quality leads, and operations for deployments and overall end-to-end implementation.

Additionally, this role is responsible for comprehensive project planning, risk... management, change management, communication management, as well as maintaining a good client relationship throughout the project lifecycle.

The Technical Project Manager will maintain project budget and manage delivery to ensure profitability.

Principal accountabilities :
• Lead or facilitate sessions to gather business process requirements and technical team standups ensuring technical feasibility.
• Develop comprehensive project plans, set schedules for all stakeholders, execute each step of the project, maintain project time frames, budget estimates, and status reports to be shared with internal and external clients.
• Ensure resource availability and allocation.
• Perform risk management and mitigation planning.
• Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs to include generating cost proposals and change orders.
• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Excellent customer service skills with the ability to develop long-term trusted relationships with external and internal stakeholders.
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation including internal and external meeting minutes.
• Report and escalate to management as needed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Our ideal candidate will have :
• Substantial Technical Project Management experience.
• Experience leading a global team and working with external and internal clients.
• Candidates with a background in healthcare IT are preferred.
• Strong verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience in project planning, risk management, change controls, resource allocation, budgeting, and profitability management.

Why Join?

Those who join us become part of a recognized global leader still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care.

You will have access to the most cutting-edge technology, the largest data sets, the best analytics tools and, in our opinion, some of the finest minds in the Healthcare industry.

You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.

Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.

It's an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.

IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success.

We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry.

We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Google Solutions - 9 months
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Our client is one of the Big Five companies in the American information technology industry that specialises in Internet-related services and products, which include online advertising technologies, a search engine, cloud computing, software, and hardware.

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

Challenge
• Anticipate, identify, and recommend creative ways to improve on solutions to defined problems via evaluation and analysis of data and business needs.
• Troubleshoot commonly escalated issues or triage when required.

Influence
• Work within one or more teams to communicate project knowledge and priorities, providing guidance to more junior team members.
• Identify key stakeholders internally and externally to build networks and contribute to cross-team collaborations and training.
• As needed, act as a point of contact in TVC engagements (e.g., escalation).
• Communicate effectively with internal teams.
• Coordinate timelines, goals, and objectives for assigned... component(s) of a client/stakeholder project.
• Identify and recommend creative ways to leverage and/or enhance existing processes and/or tools through optimisation.

Expertise
• Demonstrate full-working knowledge of areas of expertise, and an understanding of related areas of the Google organisation, including understanding of technologies, process impacts, and upstream/downstream processes and functions.
• Exercise working knowledge of translating commercial business models/needs into solutions.

Responsibilities under the direction of Google Manager

Driving efficiencies
• Support updating of existing solution content or create repeatable content (e.g., best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code) and ensure effective documentation of repeatable solutions.
• Contribute to delivery of business efficiency plans (BEP), recognises current inefficiencies and proposes options.

Partner strategy for solutions
• Help generate partner insights and participate in business reviews with partners to formulate partner strategies, with minimal guidance. Help provide reactive consultation to partners to identify new business opportunities. Contribute to the execution of partner strategies to adopt Google technologies.

Project management
• Manage project planning, status reporting, time-line estimation, issue tracking, meeting facilitation, and project documentation.
• Propose next steps and roadblock solutions and anticipate questions and challenges.

Solution delivery
• Execute solutions, with occasional support from peers/community, based on user/partner/client business objectives and technical requirements that have been previously defined, developed, and approved.

Solution delivery improvement
• Help identify trends of solution issues across users/partners/clients and collaborate with internal teams (e.g., engineering) to mitigate risks in the future with some guidance. Contribute to developing initiatives and practices to improve solution delivery, develop new delivery workflows, and drive solution innovation with some guidance.

Solution development and scoping
• Help leverage, customise, or develop technical or nontechnical solutions based on defined user/partner/client business objectives that are compliant with legal, with minimal guidance.
• Support discussions with internal teams and users/partners/clients to define solution constraints and scope with minimal guidance. Help articulate the value of solutions through design sessions with the user/partner/client with minimal guidance.
• Support architecture design and/or feature requests with product teams for solution development.

Solution strategy
• Support defining of long-term solution strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and influence the direction and priority of technical product features and/or the solution with minimal guidance.

User customer experience feedback
• Support assessment and identification of gaps and issues in current products based on user feedback or metrics analysis and quantify impact of solving/the consequences of leaving issues unsolved.
• Support communication of product gaps and issues to internal teams (e.g., Product Management, Business Development, Engineering).
• Support solving gaps and issues by contribution that can take the form of developing, validating, and documenting new features/solutions for internal or external products.

¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

Stakeholder management for solutions
• Support collaboration with manager-level stakeholders to troubleshoot or develop the most optimal solutions and enhance offerings.
• Support coaching internal and external teams on new solutions/systems, user/partner/client ecosystem, and industry landscape.
• Address escalations to and from stakeholders.

Stakeholder relationship management
• Help to build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders in user/partner/client/internal organisations to deliver or manage quality solutions and services with minimal guidance.
• Contribute to advising on best practices to optimise internal stakeholder/client use of technology to support their business processes with minimal guidance.
• Help enhance relationships and seek out new opportunities through consultation and engagement with minimal guidance.

SKILLS/EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION:

Consultative skills
• Ability to understand stakeholder needs through dialogue before conducting analysis and making recommendations.

Customer conversations
• Ability to utilise open, closed, and leading questioning techniques to understand underlying beliefs, motivations, and causes for behaviours, needs, and desires.

Domain-specific knowledge and skill
• Ability to develop, understand, and apply domain-specific technical knowledge to complete assigned work, tasks, and support others in the organisation.

Google solutions
• Ability to articulate how customers and partners can use Google products, services, and solutions to identify needs, solve problems, and drive growth.

Industry knowledge
• Knowledge of the changing landscape of the industry, product areas, other key players, and/or markets including technology trends and issues that affect the operations of one's business and organisation.

Operations management
• Ability to manage and execute operational processes, including adherence to documented procedures, definition of SLAs, definition of location and time zone strategy, capacity planning, quality control and oversight of outsourcing partners.

Opportunity and pipeline management
• Ability to discover opportunities to deliver expanded customer value by effectively managing the pipeline throughout the entire sales/customer lifecycle.

Problem-solving
• Ability to use critical thinking and diverse data to solve problems, drive decision-making, and make improvements.

Project management
• Knowledge of project planning methodology, deployment planning process, and sequence. This includes the ability to understand, or to manage smaller parts or phases of a bigger project, or an understanding of how to translate capacity demand into a low-level production system project plan.

Situational leadership
• Ability to interact confidently, clearly, and respectfully with others, especially senior leaders of the organisation, to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program or solution. This includes the ability to effectively address difficult questions, handle push-backs from a high-level audience, and maintain a professional demeanour while engaging in difficult or sometimes high-pressure situations.

Stakeholder management
• Ability to create positive relationships with stakeholders through the appropriate management of expectations and agreed objectives. Including building trust, collaborative relationships, and rapport with different functional stakeholders.

Systems thinking
• Understanding of the processes involved with studying a procedure within a business area to identify its goals and purposes and create systems and procedures that will achieve them in an efficient way.

Technical acumen
• Ability to quickly learn the general concepts and principles in a statistical and mathematical domain, solve or analyse issues or provide useful insights, and demonstrate interest and curiosity in acquiring knowledge across similar domains.

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?

We offer a 9-month contract based in Madrid

The work will be in hybrid format: 2 days off-site and 3 days on-site

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
The role has overall responsibility for the effective implementation and maintenance of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) within Allianz Technology. Furthermore, the role is responsible for planning and overseeing Security Projects within an organization. The scope of Expert / PM covers several Business Units (usually the entire or part of Europe, Americas or APAC regions).

You will:
• The Security Expert is responsible for preventing and mitigating security breaches by overseeing the related ISMS activities, risk identification and assessment, prevention and advice with respect to the Information Security Risk areas.
• The function is responsible for the effective implementation of Allianz Technology’s Information Security principles.
• As a project manager, the role is responsible for planning and overseeing Security-relevant projects.
• The role provides Project Management and Security expertise to support change related activities worldwide.

Your skills:
• Higher... education degree in IT or comparable technical education
• Information Security experience related to project management, risk management & compliance programs
• Experience with internal controls, risk assessments, business process and internal IT control testing or operational auditing.
• Previous experience in Project Management.
• Understanding of information security and risk frameworks/standards (ISO 27001/2, NIST, PCI-DSS, COBIT etc.).
• Project management and reporting experience and the ability to operate in a deadline-oriented environment.
• Excellent verbal, written communication skills and experience presenting across the various levels within the business up to senior leadership.
• Proven analytical, audit and investigative skills, judgement and reasoning ability.

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. The role has overall responsibility for the effective implementation and maintenance of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) within Allianz Technology. Furthermore, the role is responsible for planning and overseeing Security Projects within an organization. The scope of Expert / PM covers several Business Units (usually the entire or part of Europe, Americas or APAC regions).

You will:
• The Security Expert is responsible for preventing and mitigating security breaches by overseeing the related ISMS activities, risk identification and assessment, prevention and advice with respect to the Information Security Risk areas.
• The function is responsible for the effective implementation of Allianz Technology’s Information Security principles.
• As a project manager, the role is responsible for planning and overseeing Security-relevant projects.
• The role provides Project Management and Security expertise to support change related activities worldwide.

Your skills:
• Higher... education degree in IT or comparable technical education
• Information Security experience related to project management, risk management & compliance programs
• Experience with internal controls, risk assessments, business process and internal IT control testing or operational auditing.
• Previous experience in Project Management.
• Understanding of information security and risk frameworks/standards (ISO 27001/2, NIST, PCI-DSS, COBIT etc.).
• Project management and reporting experience and the ability to operate in a deadline-oriented environment.
• Excellent verbal, written communication skills and experience presenting across the various levels within the business up to senior leadership.
• Proven analytical, audit and investigative skills, judgement and reasoning ability.

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.
